risks.title: Economic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Economic risk is high due to the company's dependence on global economic conditions, including conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, tensions between China and Taiwan, and currency exchange rate volatility.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a market with increased competition, which may lead to pricing pressure and margin compression.

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on wafer suppliers, particularly in Japan, which may result in supply chain disruption risks and foreign exchange exposure.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to foreign exchange risks, particularly due to volatility in the exchange rate between the U.S. dollar and the Japanese yen; a 10% change in the dollar versus the yen would impact gross margin by approximately 1.5%.

risks.title: Litigation and Disputes
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in litigation and disputes, including an employee-related dispute, which may result in financial costs and losses.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputational risks, particularly related to product and service quality.

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, particularly related to data protection and IT systems.

ai_positioning.summary: Power Integrations, Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
